We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts: a construction site, operator of a loader (铲车) driving, reversed, negligently hits a motorcyclist (electric bike) causing death. This is likely "交通肇事罪" (traffic accident causing death) under Chinese criminal law. The operator is not a motor vehicle driver? He is operating a loader (construction vehicle) on a construction site. Could be "以危险方法危害公共安全罪"? But typical case: causing death by dangerous driving, negligence. Chinese law: Article 133 of Criminal Law: "交通肇事罪" (traffic accident). It applies to drivers of motor vehicles, motorcycles, etc. Does a loader count as a motor vehicle? It is a motorized vehicle, likely considered a "机动车". So charge: "交通肇事罪". Also possibly "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide) but Chinese law uses "交通肇事罪". The examples: earlier they used "失火" for arson, "容留他人吸毒", "非国家工作人员受贿", "诈骗;组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫;引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" (multiple). For the arson case they used "放火". For the assault they used "故意伤害". For false terror info they used "编造、故意传播虚假恐怖信息". So they use Chinese legal terms.

Thus answer: [罪名]交通肇事罪<eoa>
